body_html:
How it works

Two perpendicular number lines, the x-axis and the y-axis, meet at the origin O(0, 0) and divide the plane into four quadrants (I to IV, anticlockwise from the top right).

A point is written (x, y): the abscissa x first, then the ordinate y. Signs: I (+, +), II (−, +), III (−, −), IV (+, −). Points on an axis are in no quadrant.

Example

Where is (−4, 3)?

x negative, y positive

Answer: Quadrant II

Example

How far is (5, −2) from the x-axis?

The distance from the x-axis is |y|

Answer: 2 units

Common mistakes

  • Swapping the coordinates: (2, 5) and (5, 2) are different points.
  • Numbering the quadrants clockwise. They go anticlockwise.
  • Saying a point like (0, 4) is in quadrant I. It lies on the y-axis.

faq.q: What is the abscissa and the ordinate?
faq.a: For the point (x, y), the abscissa is the x-coordinate and the ordinate is the y-coordinate.
Anticlockwise from the top right: I (+, +), II (−, +), III (−, −), IV (+, −).

faq.q: Which quadrant does a point on an axis belong to?
faq.a: None. A point on an axis is not in any quadrant.

faq.q: How far is a point (x, y) from the axes?
faq.a: Its distance from the x-axis is |y| and from the y-axis is |x|.

items.q: In which quadrant does the point (−9, 9) lie?
items.e: x is negative and y is positive, so the point is in quadrant II.

items.q: In which quadrant does the point (1, 4) lie?
items.e: x is positive and y is positive, so the point is in quadrant I.

items.q: In which quadrant does the point (4, 4) lie?
items.e: x is positive and y is positive, so the point is in quadrant I.

items.q: In which quadrant does the point (−1, −1) lie?

items.e: x is positive and y is negative, so the point is in quadrant IV.

items.q: In which quadrant is the abscissa negative and the ordinate positive?
items.e: Left and up is quadrant II. Quadrant II.

items.q: In which quadrant does the point (8, 1) lie?
items.e: x is positive and y is positive, so the point is in quadrant I.

items.q: In which quadrant does the point (−4, 1) lie?
items.e: x is negative and y is positive, so the point is in quadrant II.

items.q: In which quadrant does the point (2, −7) lie?
items.e: x is positive and y is negative, so the point is in quadrant IV.

items.q: In which quadrant are both coordinates negative?
items.e: Left (x < 0) and down (y < 0) is quadrant III. Quadrant III.

items.q: In which quadrant does the point (7, −4) lie?
items.e: x is positive and y is negative, so the point is in quadrant IV.

items.q: In which quadrant does the point (8, 5) lie?
items.e: x is positive and y is positive, so the point is in quadrant I.

items.q: The quadrants are numbered ___.
c: clockwise, starting from the top left
anticlockwise, starting from the top right
anticlockwise, starting from the bottom left
clockwise, starting from the top right
items.e: Quadrant I is top right; the numbering goes anticlockwise. anticlockwise, starting from the top right.

items.q: The x-coordinate of a point is also called its ___.
items.e: The x-coordinate is the abscissa. abscissa.

items.q: In which quadrant does the point (5, 4) lie?
items.e: x is positive and y is positive, so the point is in quadrant I.

items.q: The signs of the coordinates of a point in quadrant I are ___.
items.e: Quadrant I is right and up. (+, +).

items.q: The axes divide the plane into four parts called ___.
items.e: Each of the four parts is a quadrant. quadrants.

items.q: The coordinates of the origin are ___.
items.e: The origin is 0 along both axes. (0, 0).

items.q: In which quadrant is the abscissa positive and the ordinate negative?
items.e: Right and down is quadrant IV. Quadrant IV.
